name: corelift
description: Connect your SAP system and let agents lift custom ABAP apps to clean core: read-only discovery, reference screenshots, pinned SAP API evidence, assessment, and target code drafted on the stack you choose through gated checkpoints.

interface.shortDescription: Lift and shift SAP custom code to clean core
interface.longDescription: CoreLift reads your custom ABAP code from your SAP system (read-only), checks every SAP dependency against SAP's published Cloudification Repository, recommends where each app should go and drafts its target code in a local folder for your review. Nothing is written to SAP or BTP. No SAP system yet? Try the built-in fictional demo system first.
capabilities: Assess custom code for clean core
defaultPrompt: Lift and shift my SAP custom code using the demo system
